# EZ Plumbing & Heating

> Plumbing and heating company serving Airdrie, Calgary and surrounding area
> (Alberta, Canada) since 2007. Boiler repair and installation specialists,
> recommended by boiler manufacturer reps and trusted by condo boards and
> property managers. Honest advice, quality workmanship, fair prices, no
> pressure sales. 24/7 emergency service. Call 403-899-9687.

## Services
- [Boiler Repair & Installation](https://www.ezplumbingandheating.com/boilers.html): In-depth boiler diagnosis, repair, installation and maintenance for homes, condo buildings and commercial properties. Authorized NTI dealer.
- [Combi Furnace Repair & Installation](https://www.ezplumbingandheating.com/combi-furnace.html): High-efficiency combination heating and on-demand hot water units, honestly sized, installed to manufacturer spec.
- [Plumbing Repairs](https://www.ezplumbingandheating.com/plumbing-repairs.html): Faucets, toilets, burst and frozen pipes, drains, leak detection. 24/7 emergency response.
- [All Services](https://www.ezplumbingandheating.com/services.html): Water heaters and tankless (Vesta/NTI authorized dealer), drain cleaning, frozen pipe repair, renovations.

## Company
- [Why EZ](https://www.ezplumbingandheating.com/why-ez.html): Mission and values. Honest advice, quality workmanship, fair price, and a no-pressure promise.

- [Our Work](https://www.ezplumbingandheating.com/our-work.html): Recent projects including condo boiler replacements, in-floor heating restoration and commercial tankless conversions.
